args.title: Corvid Packaging: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (article + companion)
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data (Corvid Packaging, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026").
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
